note: Field audit_procedure / remediation_procedure / default_value / references diekstrak langsung dari CIS PDF agar sistem dapat menampilkan 'cara cek' dan 'cara perbaiki' pada setiap finding. Import idempotent: upsert by (vendor, code).

rules.title: Ensure DNS server is configured
rules.expected_value: Trusted DNS server configured (instead of default 96.45.45.45 / 96.45.46.46)
rules.rationale: Perform hostname to IP resolution using a trusted DNS server to prevent man-in-the-middle.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system dns
shows

GUI: Network > DNS. Make sure to use a trusted DNS (default FortiGuard or custom).
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system dns
  set primary 8.8.8.8
  set secondary 8.8.4.4
end

GUI: Network > DNS > Specify, isi Primary & Secondary DNS.

rules.title: Ensure intra-zone traffic is not always allowed
rules.expected_value: set intrazone deny on the relevant zone
rules.rationale: Adding layers of protection between networks in the same zone; only authorized traffic is permitted.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system zone
  edit <ZONE>
  show full (check: set intrazone deny)

GUI: Network > Interfaces > select zone > Edit > ensure 'Block intra-zone traffic' is active.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system zone
  edit <ZONE>
  set intrazone deny
end

GUI: aktifkan 'Block intra-zone traffic' pada zone.
rules.default_value: Intra-zone traffic is blocked by default

rules.title: Disable all management related services on WAN port
rules.expected_value: allowaccess on WAN does not contain ping/https/http/ssh/snmp/radius-acct
rules.rationale: Management service can only be in the management interface; reduce the attack surface on the WAN.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
show system interface
Identify the WAN interface, make sure 'set allowaccess' does not contain ping, https, http, ssh, snmp, radius-acct.

GUI: Network > Interfaces > WAN > check Administrative Access.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system interface
  edit "port1"
  unselect allowaccess ping https ssh snmp http radius-acct
end

GUI: nonaktifkan HTTPS/HTTP/ping/SSH/SNMP/Radius pada interface WAN. Untuk IPsec/SSLVPN gunakan local-in-policy (lihat 2.4).

rules.title: Ensure 'Pre-Login Banner' is set
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Login banners reduce the risk of unauthorized access and strengthen the legal position against illegal access.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek: pre-login-banner : enable)

GUI: System > Replacement Messages > Extended View > 'Pre-login Disclaimer Message'.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set pre-login-banner enable
end

GUI: edit isi 'Pre-login Disclaimer Message' lalu Save.

rules.title: Ensure 'Post-Login-Banner' is set
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Post-login banner (MOTD) provides notification of legal rights & consent monitoring.
rules.impact: Script otomatis mungkin terpengaruh karena CLI/GUI butuh aksi 'Accept'.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek: post-login-banner : enable)

GUI: System > Replacement Messages > Extended View > 'Post-login Disclaimer Message'.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set post-login-banner enable
end

rules.title: Ensure timezone is properly configured
rules.expected_value: According to location (not the default GMT-8 Pacific)
rules.rationale: Accurate time is important for the validity of certificates & timestamp logs.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek field: timezone)

GUI: System > Settings > System Time.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
global system config
  set timezone <id> (type 'set timezone ?' for a list of IDs)
end

rules.title: Ensure correct system time is configured through NTP
rules.expected_value: Trusted NTP server configured (primary & secondary); sync status = runtime
rules.rationale: NTP maintains accurate time for event correlation, logging, and cryptographic functions. Use SHA1 when using symmetric keys (avoid MD5).
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
diag sys ntp status   (cek: synchronized: yes)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system ntp
  set type custom
  config ntpserver
    edit 1
      set server pool.ntp.org
    next
    edit 2
      set server 1.1.1.1
  end
end

rules.title: Ensure hostname is set
rules.expected_value: Not default (not model number)
rules.rationale: Hostnames are important for asset inventory, certificate deployment, and log correlation.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek field: hostname)

GUI: System > Settings > Hostname.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set hostname "New_FGT1"
end

rules.title: Ensure the latest firmware is installed
rules.expected_value: Latest stable firmware; no open CVEs (compare to PSIRT)
rules.rationale: The latest firmware prevents exploitation of known vulnerabilities.
rules.audit_procedure:
1. Check the latest version at https://docs.fortinet.com/upgrade-tool.
2. CLI: get system status (check Version).
3. Check CVE at https://www.fortiguard.com/psirt?product=FortiOS
rules.remediation_procedure: Determine the upgrade path via https://docs.fortinet.com/upgrade-tool, download the firmware from https://support.fortinet.com, then upgrade via GUI: System > Fabric Management > Upgrade (follow the path).

rules.title: Disable USB Firmware and configuration installation
rules.expected_value: auto-install-config disable & auto-install-image disable
rules.rationale: Prevents manipulated config/firmware from being automatically loaded via USB.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system auto-install
get   (cek auto-install-config & auto-install-image disabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system auto-install
  set auto-install-config disable
  set auto-install-image disable
end

rules.title: Disable static keys for TLS
rules.expected_value: disable
rules.rationale: Prevent terminated TLS sessions on FortiGate using static SSL keys.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
get   (cek ssl-static-key-ciphers disabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set ssl-static-key-ciphers disable
end

rules.title: Enable Global Strong Encryption
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Forcing FortiOS to only use strong encryption & ciphers.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
get   (cek strong-crypto enabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set strong-crypto enable
end

rules.title: Ensure management GUI listens on secure TLS version
rules.expected_value: tlsv1-3 (minimal tlsv1-2)
rules.rationale: Use high version of TLS to prevent MiTM attacks on GUI access.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
get   (cek admin-https-ssl-versions tlsv1-3)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set admin-https-ssl-versions tlsv1-3
end

rules.title: Ensure CDN is enabled for improved GUI performance
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Loading static GUI artifacts via CDN for performance; NOT a security control (informational).
rules.impact: Tidak ada dampak keamanan jika tidak diaktifkan.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
get   (cek gui-cdn-usage enabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set gui-cdn-usage enable
end

rules.title: Ensure single CPU core overloaded event is logged
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Detects single CPU core overload that can be missed on multi-core devices.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
get   (cek log-single-cpu-high enabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set log-single-cpu-high enable
end

rules.title: Ensure Hostname is Not Displayed On Login GUI
rules.expected_value: disable
rules.rationale: The hostname on the login page can be information for reconnaissance.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global | grep -f gui-display   (cek gui-display-hostname: disable)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set gui-display-hostname disable
end

rules.title: Ensure 'Password Policy' is enabled
rules.expected_value: status enable, minimum-length >= 14, apply-to admin-password ipsec-preshared-key (scope both)
rules.rationale: Complex/long passwords prevent brute force. CIS: minimum 14 characters.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system password-policy

GUI: System > Settings > Password Policy (scope=Both, Minimum length=14).
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system password-policy
  set status enable
  set apply-to admin-password ipsec-preshared-key
  set minimum-length 14
end

rules.title: Ensure administrator password retries and lockout time are configured
rules.expected_value: admin-lockout-threshold <= 3 dan admin-lockout-duration <= 900
rules.rationale: Limit failed login attempts to minimize brute force.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek admin-lockout-threshold & admin-lockout-duration)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set admin-lockout-threshold 3
  set admin-lockout-duration 900
end

rules.title: Ensure only SNMPv3 is enabled
rules.config_key: config system snmp community / config system snmp user
rules.expected_value: There is no community SNMPv1/v2c; SNMPv3 users only (auth-priv, sha256/aes256)
rules.rationale: SNMPv3 adds authentication & privacy; v1/v2c sends clear text data.
rules.impact: SNMP server lama (v1/v2c) tidak bisa query.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp sysinfo (show; status enable)
config system snmp community (show; harus kosong)
config system snmp user (show; ada user v3)

GUI: System > SNMP.
rules.remediation_procedure: CLI: aktifkan agent (config system snmp sysinfo > set status enable), hapus community v1/v2c (delete <id>), tambah user v3 (security-level auth-priv, auth-proto sha256, priv-proto aes256).

rules.title: Allow only trusted hosts in SNMPv3
rules.expected_value: notify-hosts contains specific IPs; no 0.0.0.0
rules.rationale: Restricts SNMP information to only relevant devices (NMS).
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
show system snmp user   (cek notify-hosts = IP spesifik, tanpa 0.0.0.0)

GUI: System > SNMP > SNMPv3 > Hosts.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp user
  edit <user>
  unselect notify-hosts 0.0.0.0
end

rules.title: Disable SNMPv3 Query Per User
rules.expected_value: disable (for users who only accept traps)
rules.rationale: SNMP queries can be used for reconnaissance; turn it off on user trap-only.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp user (cek: set queries disable)

GUI: System > SNMP > user > slider Queries.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp user
  edit <user>
  set queries disable
next
end

rules.title: Enabling SNMP trap for memory usage
rules.config_key: config system snmp sysinfo > trap-free-memory-threshold / trap-freeable-memory-threshold
rules.expected_value: Threshold dikonfigurasi (mis. trap-free-memory 20, trap-freeable-memory 50)
rules.rationale: Critical memory triggers conserve mode which interferes with security inspections; trap provides early warning.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp sysinfo
show   (cek trap-free-memory-threshold & trap-freeable-memory-threshold)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system snmp sysinfo
  set status enable
  set trap-free-memory-threshold 20
  set trap-freeable-memory-threshold 50
end

rules.title: Remove default admin user and create one with other name
rules.expected_value: There is no user named 'admin'; default credentials are not valid
rules.rationale: Vendor-documented default credentials are therefore the first target of attacks.
rules.audit_procedure: CLI/GUI: try logging in with username 'admin' without password; If successful, it means the default is still active.
rules.remediation_procedure:
1) Create a new admin:
config system admin
  edit "mycompanyadmin"
  set password <pwd>
  set accprofile "super_admin"
next
end
2) Verify new account login, then clear default:
config system admin
  delete "admin"
end

rules.title: Ensure all the login accounts having specific trusted hosts enabled
rules.expected_value: Each admin account has a specific trusted host (not 0.0.0.0/0)
rules.rationale: Admin access only from trusted network segments; additional layer of security.
rules.impact: Akses dari luar segmen diblokir termasuk admin sah (perlu jump host).
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system admin
  edit <akun>
  show   (cek set trusthost1 ...)

GUI: System > Administrators > akun > 'Restrict login to trusted hosts'.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system admin
  edit <akun>
  set trusthost1 10.0.0.0 255.255.255.0
end
rules.default_value: Each account can be accessed from anywhere (0.0.0.0/0)

rules.title: Ensure admin accounts with different privileges have their correct profiles assigned
rules.config_key: config system accprofile + config system admin > accprofile
rules.expected_value: Least privilege: each account uses an accprofile according to its role
rules.rationale: Different admin levels (tier 1/2/3) require appropriate minimum privileges.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
Stage 1: config system accprofile > edit <profile> > show full
Stage 2: config system admin > edit <akun> > show full (cek accprofile)

GUI: System > Admin Profiles & Administrators.
rules.remediation_procedure: CLI: customize accprofile (e.g. fwgrp custom, set address read-write) then assign to account: set accprofile <profile>.

rules.title: Ensure Admin idle timeout time is configured
rules.expected_value: <= 15 minutes (ideal 5). >15 has a negative impact on the security rating.
rules.rationale: Prevents unauthorized access to abandoned GUI sessions.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
get system global   (cek admintimeout, dalam menit)

GUI: System > Settings > Administration Settings > Idle timeout.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set admintimeout 5
end

rules.title: Ensure only encrypted access channels are enabled
rules.expected_value: allowaccess does not contain http & telnet (only ssh/https)
rules.rationale: Only encrypted access to prevent credential sniffing (MiTM).
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system interface > edit <iface> > show (cek allowaccess tanpa http/telnet)

GUI: Network > Interfaces > Administrative Access.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system interface
  edit <iface>
  set allowaccess ssh https ping snmp
end
rules.default_value: HTTP & Telnet are not active on any interface

rules.title: Apply Local-in Policies
rules.expected_value: There is a local-in-policy to control traffic to the FortiGate interface
rules.rationale: Local-in policy provides granular control of traffic to the FortiGate interface, beyond trusted hosts.
rules.impact: Diproses sebelum trusted host; validasi agar akses manajemen tidak terputus.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config firewall local-in-policy
show

GUI: aktifkan via System > Feature Visibility > Local-in policies.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI (hanya via CLI):
config firewall local-in-policy
  edit <id>
  set intf <iface>
  set srcaddr <addr>
  set dstaddr all
  set action {accept|deny}
  set service <svc>
  set schedule always
next
end
rules.default_value: There is no local-in-policy by default

rules.title: Ensure default Admin ports are changed
rules.config_key: config system global > admin-port / admin-sport / admin-https-redirect
rules.expected_value: admin-port & admin-sport bukan 80/443; admin-https-redirect disable
rules.rationale: Changing the default admin port reduces attack surface & port conflicts.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: System > Settings > Administration Settings (cek port).
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system global
  set admin-https-redirect disable
  set admin-port 8082
  set admin-sport 4343
end
Hindari port: 8080/8081, 4433, 10443.

rules.title: Virtual patching on the local-in management interface
rules.expected_value: virtual-patch enable on policies that allow traffic (requires FMWP license)
rules.rationale: IPS signature (FMWP) provides virtual patching of GUI/SSH access before official patches are applied.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config firewall local-in-policy
show   (cek virtual-patch enable)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config firewall local-in-policy
  edit <id>
  set virtual-patch enable
next
end

rules.title: Ensure High Availability configuration is enabled
rules.config_key: config system ha > mode / group-name / hbdev
rules.expected_value: a-a or a-p mode; group-name, password, hbdev are configured
rules.rationale: HA increases availability & reduces the impact of maintenance/device failure.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
show   (cek mode, group-name, hbdev)

GUI: System > HA.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
  set mode a-p
  set group-name "FGT-HA"
  set password <pwd>
  set hbdev port10 50
end

rules.title: Ensure "Monitor Interfaces" for High Availability devices is enabled
rules.expected_value: Critical interfaces are included in the 'monitor set'
rules.rationale: Interface monitoring allows failover when the physical media/port has problems.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
show   (cek set monitor "portX" "portY")

GUI: System > HA > Monitor Interfaces.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
  set monitor "port6" "port7"
end

rules.title: Ensure HA Reserved Management Interface is configured
rules.expected_value: ha-mgmt-status enable + minimal 1 interface & gateway
rules.rationale: So that primary & secondary can be accessed directly without sharing a virtual MAC.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
show   (cek ha-mgmt-status enable & ha-mgmt-interfaces)

GUI: System > HA > Management Interface Reservation.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
  set ha-mgmt-status enable
  config ha-mgmt-interfaces
    edit 1
      set interface port6
      set gateway 10.10.10.1
  end
end

rules.title: Ensure High Availability Group-ID is configured
rules.expected_value: group-id is not default 0 (0-1023)
rules.rationale: Group-ID generates virtual MAC; non-default prevents MAC duplication in L2.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
show sys ha   (cek set group-id != 0)

GUI: System > HA > Cluster Settings > Group ID.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system ha
  set group-id 10
end

rules.title: Ensure that unused policies are reviewed regularly
rules.expected_value: No-hit policy reviewed; disable/unused log (review 2x/year)
rules.rationale: Keeps the rule base slim & prevents traffic from being accidentally allowed/blocked.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
diag firewall iprope show 100004 <policy_id>
diag firewall iprope clear 100004 <policy_id>

GUI: Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy > kolom Hit Count/Bytes.
rules.remediation_procedure: Review & delete/disable unused policies based on hit count.

rules.title: Ensure that policies do not use "ALL" as Service
rules.expected_value: There is no policy with service 'ALL'
rules.rationale: Prevents the firewall from accidentally allowing unauthorized protocols/services.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config firewall policy
show   (cek tidak ada set service "ALL")

GUI: Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config firewall policy
  edit <id>
  set service "FTP" "SNMP"   (ganti dengan service spesifik)
end

rules.title: Ensure firewall policy denying all traffic to/from Tor, malicious server, or scanner IP addresses using ISDB
rules.expected_value: Ada policy deny inbound & outbound untuk ISDB (Tor, Botnet-C&C, Phishing, Proxy, Spam, Anonymous VPN, Malicious, Scanner)
rules.rationale: Filter malicious traffic as the first layer without heavy processes like IPS.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Policy & Objects > cek policy deny inbound (source ISDB) & outbound (destination ISDB) dengan logging enabled.
rules.remediation_procedure: Buat 2 policy deny: (1) Inbound - source = ISDB list, action Deny, log enable; (2) Outbound - destination = ISDB list, action Deny, log enable. (ISDB list per Dec 2024/FortiOS 7.4.5)

rules.title: Ensure logging is enabled on all firewall policies
rules.expected_value: Allow policy: log all sessions; Deny policy: log violation traffic (termasuk implicit deny)
rules.rationale: Logging of all policies enables SOC/IR investigations & threat hunting.
rules.impact: Default logging tidak aktif; menciptakan data gap.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy (validasi logging enabled di semua policy).
rules.remediation_procedure: Untuk allow: 'Log Allowed Traffic' = All Sessions. Untuk deny: 'Log Violation Traffic' = enable.

rules.title: (Extra, non-CIS) Any-Any-Any firewall policy detected
rules.config_key: config firewall policy > srcaddr=all & dstaddr=all & service=ALL
rules.expected_value: There is no policy with src=all, dst=all, service=ALL
rules.rationale: The any-any-any policy opens up a very wide attack surface; complement 3.2 & 3.4.
rules.audit_procedure: Parser cek setiap policy: srcaddr 'all' & dstaddr 'all' & service 'ALL' & action accept.
rules.remediation_procedure: Restrict src/dst to specific subnet/host, change specific services, enable security profile & logging.

rules.title: Detect Botnet connections
rules.expected_value: Block outgoing botnet, applied to policy with WAN destination
rules.rationale: Block outgoing connections to the botnet as part of defense-in-depth.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: ensure IPS profile 'Scan Outgoing Connections to Botnet Sites' = Block; review the policy with the WAN destination.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: set IPS profile botnet = Block; apply IPS profile to all outbound traffic policies to the WAN.

rules.title: Apply IPS Security Profile to Policies
rules.expected_value: IPS profile is applied to inter-interface policy (allowed)
rules.rationale: Traffic between interfaces must be inspected by IPS.
rules.audit_procedure: Review all firewall policies: ensure there is an IPS security profile for inspection.
rules.remediation_procedure: Apply the appropriate IPS security profile to all 'Allowed' policies.

rules.title: Ensure Antivirus Definition Push Updates are Configured
rules.expected_value: Scheduled updates = Automatic
rules.rationale: Ensure that the AV database signature is always up to date from FortiGuard.
rules.audit_procedure:
GUI: System > FortiGuard > Scheduled updates = Automatic.
CLI: config system autoupdate schedule > show (kosong = automatic).
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config system autoupdate schedule
  set status enable
  set frequency automatic
end

rules.title: Apply Antivirus Security Profile to Policies
rules.expected_value: AV profile is applied to the relevant policy
rules.rationale: Traffic between interfaces must be inspected by antivirus.
rules.audit_procedure: Review all firewall policies: make sure there is an AV security profile.
rules.remediation_procedure: Apply the appropriate AV security profile to the relevant policy.
rules.default_value: There is no inspection on the policy

rules.title: Enable Outbreak Prevention Database
rules.expected_value: outbreak-prevention block for each protocol
rules.rationale: Adds a FortiGuard signature hash layer on top of signature-based AV.
rules.audit_procedure:
GUI: Security Profiles > AntiVirus > 'Use FortiGuard outbreak prevention database' enabled.
CLI: config antivirus profile > show.
rules.remediation_procedure: Activate 'Use FortiGuard outbreak prevention database' in the AV profile (set outbreak-prevention block).

rules.title: Enable AI/heuristic based malware detection
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: AI model detects potentially malicious Windows PEs for zero-day mitigation.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
show antivirus settings | grep machine-learning-detection
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config antivirus settings
  set machine-learning-detection enable
end

rules.title: Enable grayware detection on antivirus
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Grayware can be used for malicious purposes; signature is updated like AV.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
show antivirus settings | grep grayware
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config antivirus settings
  set grayware enable
end

rules.title: Ensure inline scanning with FortiGuard AI-Based Sandbox Service is enabled
rules.config_key: config system fortiguard > sandbox-inline-scan + AV profile fortisandbox
rules.expected_value: sandbox-inline-scan enable + AV profile fortisandbox-mode inline & fortisandbox block
rules.rationale: Cloud sandbox (FAIS) detects unknown malware & prevents patient zero (requires FAIS license).
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI: config system fortiguard > get (cek sandbox-inline-scan enabled); config antivirus profile > show (cek fortisandbox-mode inline, fortisandbox block).
GUI: Security Fabric > Fabric Connectors > Cloud Sandbox (Inline scan); AntiVirus profile Scan strategy=Inline, Action=Block.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: aktifkan FortiGate Cloud Sandbox (Feature Visibility), set Fabric Connector Cloud Sandbox + Region + Inline scan, buat AV profile Proxy-based, Send files to FortiSandbox, Scan strategy Inline, Action Block.

rules.title: Enable CDR for proxy mode on XLSB, OpenOffice, and RTF files
rules.config_key: config antivirus profile (proxy) > Content Disarm and Reconstruction
rules.expected_value: CDR is active for office files (XLSB, OpenOffice, RTF) in AV profile proxy-mode
rules.rationale: CDR sanitizes malicious content in documents before it reaches the user.
rules.impact: Tanpa CDR, payload di dokumen dapat lolos ke user.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > AntiVirus > Proxy-based > APT Protection Options > Content Disarm and Reconstruction > 'Apply CDR to office files' enabled.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: buat AV profile Proxy-based, aktifkan CDR & 'Apply CDR to office files' (Office/OpenOffice/RTF/XLSB).

rules.title: Enable Botnet C&C Domain Blocking DNS Filter
rules.config_key: config dnsfilter profile > redirect botnet C&C
rules.expected_value: 'Redirect botnet C&C requests to Block Portal' enable + diterapkan pada policy DNS
rules.rationale: Block botnets at the DNS resolution stage as an additional layer of defense.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > DNS Filter > 'Redirect botnet C&C requests to Block Portal' enabled; pastikan policy DNS pakai DNS Filter profile.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: activate the option in the DNS Filter profile & apply it to the DNS policy.

rules.title: Ensure DNS Filter logs all DNS queries and responses
rules.expected_value: log-all-domain enable
rules.rationale: Log all DNS queries/responses for SOC/IR investigations.
rules.impact: Default: allowed DNS tidak dilog (data gap).
rules.audit_procedure:
GUI: Security Profiles > DNS Filter > 'Log all DNS queries and responses' enabled.
CLI: config dnsfilter profile > show (set log-all-domain enable).
rules.remediation_procedure: Aktifkan 'Log all DNS queries and responses' pada DNS Filter profile.

rules.title: Apply DNS Filter Security Profile to Policies
rules.expected_value: DNS Filter profile is applied to the outbound policy to the Internet
rules.rationale: Outbound traffic to the Internet must be inspected by the DNS Filter.
rules.audit_procedure: Review the outbound policy to the Internet: make sure there is a DNS Filter security profile.
rules.remediation_procedure: Apply the DNS Filter profile to the 'Allowed' outbound to the Internet policy.

rules.title: Create a Web Filtering Profile
rules.config_key: config webfilter profile > Security Risk categories
rules.expected_value: Kategori Security Risk (Malicious Websites, Phishing, Spam URLs) = Block
rules.rationale: The Security Risk category is often an attack vector (malware, phishing, C2).
rules.impact: Set 'Newly Observed/Registered Domains' ke Block dapat memblokir website baru/uncategorized.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > Web Filter > pastikan Security Risk (Malicious/Phishing/Spam URLs) = Block.
rules.remediation_procedure: Apply Web Filter profile to policy/SD-WAN; set Security Risk categories = Block.
rules.default_value: Semua kategori Security Risk & Unrated default Block

rules.title: Block high risk categories on Application Control
rules.expected_value: Kategori P2P & Proxy = Block
rules.rationale: P2P/Proxy applications are known to spread malware & can bypass inspections.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > Application Control > pastikan P2P & Proxy = Block.
rules.remediation_procedure: Set the P2P & Proxy category = Block in the App Control profile.

rules.title: Block applications running on non-default ports
rules.expected_value: enable
rules.rationale: Applications on non-default ports may indicate data exfiltration (e.g. HTTPS on 10443).
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > Application Control > 'Block applications detected on non-default ports' enabled.
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config application list
  edit <profile>
  set enforce-default-app-port enable
end

rules.title: Ensure all Application Control related traffic is logged
rules.config_key: config application list > tidak ada action 'Allow'
rules.expected_value: There are no 'Allow' action categories (use Monitor/Block), including Unknown Applications
rules.rationale: The 'Allow' action is not logged, creating a visibility gap.
rules.impact: Visibility gap mempengaruhi forensik & respons insiden.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Profiles > Application Control > make sure there is no 'Allow' action.
rules.remediation_procedure: Change all categories with action 'Allow' to 'Monitor'.

rules.title: Apply Application Control Security Profile to Policies
rules.expected_value: App Control profile is applied to inter-interface policy (allowed)
rules.rationale: Traffic between interfaces must be inspected by Application Control.
rules.audit_procedure: Review all firewall policies: make sure there is an Application Control security profile.
rules.remediation_procedure: Apply the appropriate App Control security profile to all 'Allowed' policies.

rules.title: Enable Compromised Host Quarantine
rules.config_key: config system automation-stitch > Compromised Host Quarantine
rules.expected_value: Automation stitch 'Compromised Host Quarantine' status enable (jika pakai Fabric ecosystem)
rules.rationale: Karantina otomatis host high-severity pada FortiAP/FortiSwitch/FortiClient EMS.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Fabric > Automation > pastikan 'Compromised Host Quarantine' enabled.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: Security Fabric > Automation > ubah Disabled ke Enabled (butuh FortiAP/FortiSwitch/FortiClient EMS).

rules.title: Ensure Security Fabric is Configured
rules.expected_value: Root FortiGate status enable, role 'Serve as Fabric Root' (if Fabric feature is used)
rules.rationale: Without FortiGate root, Security Fabric does not work.
rules.impact: Tanpa Fabric, visibilitas & manajemen trafik menurun.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Security Fabric > Fabric Connectors > Security Fabric Setup (status enabled, role Fabric Root, FortiAnalyzer & fabric name diisi).
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: set root FortiGate enable + role 'Serve as Fabric Root', konfigurasi FortiAnalyzer & fabric name + interface join.

rules.title: Apply a Trusted Signed Certificate for VPN Portal
rules.expected_value: Server Certificate = certificate from a trusted CA (not self-signed/factory)
rules.rationale: MiTM vulnerable self-signed certificates & connections to untrusted servers.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: VPN > SSL-VPN Settings > 'Server Certificate' = sertifikat signed.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: System > Certificates > Import; then VPN > SSL-VPN Settings > select the signed Server Certificate.

rules.title: Enable Limited TLS Versions for SSL VPN
rules.config_key: config vpn ssl settings > ssl-max-proto-ver / ssl-min-proto-ver / algorithm
rules.expected_value: ssl-max-proto-ver tls1-3, ssl-min-proto-ver tls1-2, algorithm high
rules.rationale: Restricting TLS to secure versions & strong ciphers increases the security of SSL VPN connections.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config vpn ssl settings
get
Validate:
  ssl-max-proto-ver = tls1-3
  ssl-min-proto-ver = tls1-2
  algorithm = high
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config vpn ssl settings
  set ssl-max-proto-ver tls1-3
  set ssl-min-proto-ver tls1-2
  set algorithm high
end
rules.default_value: ssl-max-proto-ver: tls1-3, ssl-min-proto-ver: tls1-2, algorithm: high

rules.title: Enable Event Logging
rules.expected_value: event enable (all event types)
rules.rationale: Event logging generates logs for review/audit & ingest to SIEM/Analyzer.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config log eventfilter
get   (validasi semua event enabled)
rules.remediation_procedure:
GUI: Log & Report > Log Settings > enable 'All' Event Logging.
CLI:
config log eventfilter
  set event enable
end

rules.title: Centralized Logging and Reporting
rules.config_key: config log syslogd setting / config log fortianalyzer setting
rules.expected_value: Logs sent to centralized devices (SIEM/Syslog/FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager)
rules.rationale: Centralized logging provides more reliable retention & richer data for review.
rules.audit_procedure: GUI: Log & Report > Log Settings > cek 'Syslog logging' offload ke device lain.
rules.remediation_procedure: GUI: Log & Report > Log Settings > remote server configuration in 'Syslog logging'.

rules.title: Encrypt Log Transmission to FortiAnalyzer / FortiManager
rules.section: 7 Logs and Reports > 7.3 Encrypt Logs in Transit
rules.config_key: config log fortianalyzer setting > reliable / enc-algorithm
rules.expected_value: reliable enable & enc-algorithm high
rules.rationale: Encryption of logs to FAZ/FMG prevents logs from being intercepted in transit.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config log fortianalyzer setting
get   (validasi enc-algorithm high & reliable enable)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config log fortianalyzer setting
  set reliable enable
  set enc-algorithm high
end

rules.title: Encrypt Log Transmission to Syslog
rules.section: 7 Logs and Reports > 7.3 Encrypt Logs in Transit
rules.config_key: config log syslog setting > reliable / enc-algorithm
rules.expected_value: reliable enable & enc-algorithm high
rules.rationale: Encryption of logs to syslog prevents logs from being intercepted in transit.
rules.note_dedup: CIS 7.3.3 identik dengan 7.3.2 (editorial duplicate). Implementasikan HANYA sekali agar tidak double-penalty.
rules.audit_procedure:
CLI:
config log syslog setting
get   (validasi enc-algorithm high & reliable enable)
rules.remediation_procedure:
CLI:
config log syslog setting
  set reliable enable
  set enc-algorithm high
end
